tasks.title: Define NotificationService Protocol with AlertRequest and AlertResult schemas
tasks.description: Create server/app/alerts/protocol.py with the @runtime_checkable NotificationService Protocol (send_alert, get_alert_history methods). Add AlertRequest and AlertResult Pydantic models to server/app/schemas.py. AlertRequest must include child_id, parent_fcm_token, message_id, label, severity, explanation, quote, child_name, source, trace_id. This interface blocks the Android FCM receiver design since the push payload shape mirrors AlertRequest.
acceptance_criteria: NotificationService Protocol exists in server/app/alerts/protocol.py with @runtime_checkable
AlertRequest Pydantic model has all 10 documented fields with correct constraints
AlertResult Pydantic model has all 8 documented fields
isinstance(FCMNotificationService(...), NotificationService) returns True
send_alert() is async; get_alert_history() is async

tasks.title: Define AlertSettings pydantic-settings model with all env vars
tasks.description: Create server/app/alerts/settings.py with AlertSettings(BaseSettings) covering: FCM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PATH (None), FCM_CHANNEL_ID ('shomer_alerts'), ALERTS_MAX_RETRY_ATTEMPTS (3), ALERTS_RETRY_BASE_SECONDS (1.0), ALERTS_RATE_LIMIT_MAX (3), ALERTS_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_S (60), ALERTS_QUEUE_MAX_SIZE (100). Note: FCM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PATH uses FCM_ prefix by exception.
acceptance_criteria: AlertSettings exists with all 7 env vars
FCM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PATH=None is a valid state (graceful no-op when FCM not configured)
ALERTS_ env prefix applied correctly; FCM_ exception documented
Default max_retry_attempts=3 and retry_base_seconds=1.0 match exponential backoff: 1s/2s/4s

tasks.title: Wire structlog bound logger shomer.alerts with required fields
tasks.description: Configure structlog.get_logger('shomer.alerts') in server/app/alerts/service.py. Every send_alert() call must emit at least one of: alerts.sent (success), alerts.rate_limited (suppressed), alerts.send_attempt_failed (retry), alerts.send_failed_queued (all retries exhausted). Required fields on every event: trace_id, alert_id, child_id, label, severity.
acceptance_criteria: alerts.sent event includes: trace_id, alert_id, child_id, label, severity, attempt, latency_ms
alerts.rate_limited event includes: trace_id, alert_id, child_id
alerts.send_failed_queued event includes: trace_id, alert_id, child_id, error
Logs inherit trace_id from structlog context var

tasks.title: Define and register Prometheus metrics for the alerts module
tasks.description: Register all 5 alerts metrics using the shared REGISTRY: alert_send_latency_seconds (Histogram with buckets to 5s), alert_send_failures_total (Counter, labels=[reason]), alert_send_success_total (Counter), alert_rate_limited_total (Counter), alert_queue_depth (Gauge). The latency histogram is the primary evidence for the p99 < 2s NFR.
acceptance_criteria: All 5 metrics registered against shared REGISTRY
alert_send_latency_seconds has buckets: 0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 5.0
alert_queue_depth Gauge is updated when items are added/removed from LocalRetryQueue
GET /metrics includes alert_send_success_total after a successful FCM send

tasks.title: Implement InMemoryRateLimiter with sliding window per child_id
tasks.description: Implement server/app/alerts/rate_limiter.py with InMemoryRateLimiter: sliding window using deque of timestamps, thread-safe with threading.Lock, max_alerts=3 per window_seconds=60 per child_id. allow() returns True and records timestamp if under limit; False if over limit. Memory bound: O(N * active_children).
acceptance_criteria: allow('child_abc') returns True for first 3 calls within 60s
allow('child_abc') returns False on 4th call within the same 60s window
After 60s the window resets and allow() returns True again
Thread-safe: concurrent allow() calls do not corrupt the deque
alert_rate_limited_total increments on every False return

tasks.title: Implement LocalRetryQueue with bounded deque and drain semantics
tasks.description: Implement server/app/alerts/retry_queue.py with LocalRetryQueue: deque(maxlen=queue_max_size=100) of AlertRequest objects. enqueue() appends; when full, oldest is dropped (deque maxlen behavior). drain() returns all items and clears the queue. size() returns current depth. The /classify handler calls drain() at the start of each request to retry queued failed alerts.
acceptance_criteria: enqueue() beyond maxlen drops the oldest item (deque maxlen behavior)
drain() returns all items and leaves the queue empty
size() returns the current number of queued items
alert_queue_depth Gauge reflects size() after every enqueue/drain

tasks.title: Implement FCMNotificationService with idempotency key and exponential backoff retry
tasks.description: Implement server/app/alerts/service.py with FCMNotificationService. Includes: _compute_alert_id() SHA-256 idempotency key (child_id:message_id:label), _build_fcm_message() with Hebrew title/body and deep-link data, _send_with_retry() with 3-attempt exponential backoff (1s/2s/4s), and init_firebase() for service account initialization. Must gracefully degrade when FCM is not configured.
acceptance_criteria: FCMNotificationService implements NotificationService Protocol
_compute_alert_id() returns same value for same inputs regardless of retry attempt
FCM message data payload includes: alert_id, child_id, message_id, label, severity, quote, source, trace_id, deep_link
3 failed FCM attempts -> request queued with queued=True in AlertResult
FCM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PATH=None -> send_alert returns AlertResult(sent=False, error='firebase not initialized') without crashing

tasks.title: Implement alerts failure modes: FCM down, bad token, queue overflow, /health degraded status
tasks.description: Implement all failure modes from LLD §8: FCM down -> retry queue + AlertResult(queued=True); Firebase not initialized -> graceful no-op; rate limit -> AlertResult(rate_limited=True); queue overflow (> 100) -> oldest dropped; Firebase not initialized sets alerts_degraded=true in /health response. Implement get_alert_history() returning empty list placeholder for Meeting 7.
acceptance_criteria: Mock FCM to fail 3 times -> AlertResult(sent=False, queued=True)
retry_queue.size() > 0 -> /health returns {alerts: {status: 'degraded', queued_alerts: N}}
AlertRequest with invalid FCM token -> HTTP 422 before send_alert is called
Queue at maxlen -> 101st enqueue drops oldest without exception
get_alert_history() returns empty list (placeholder)

tasks.title: Integration test alerts pipeline wired into FastAPI /classify endpoint

Test the full path: POST /classify with mocked classifier returning confident offensive result -> triage returns ALERT_DIRECT -> alerts.send_alert() called -> AlertResult recorded in audit. tasks.title: Create alert_history SQLite table and wire get_alert_history() query
tasks.description: Create the alert_history table in server/audit.db (schema from LLD §5) and implement the get_alert_history() method in FCMNotificationService to query alerts by child_id ordered by timestamp DESC with a limit. Write audit record on every send_alert() call. This enables the parent dashboard history endpoint.

Every send_alert() call inserts a row into alert_history
